##  Ecommerce FAQs
What ecommerce platforms is Agolia compatible with?  0
Being API first, Algolia is compatible with any ecommerce platform. In addition, Algolia has native integrations with [Salesforce Commerce Cloud](https://www.algolia.com/search-solutions/salesforce-commerce-cloud "Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with Algolia | Algolia"), [Magento](https://www.algolia.com/search-solutions/adobe-commerce-magento "Integrate Adobe Commerce - Magento with Algolia | Algolia") and [Shopify](https://www.algolia.com/search-solutions/shopify "Create amazing Shopify Plus search experiences | Algolia"). See all [integrations](https://www.algolia.com/developers/integrations "Integrations").
How does Agolia create personalized experiences during first customer interactions?  0
Algolia’s In-Session Personalization immediately assesses everything it can infer from a customer. For example, their location, action on the site, the device they are using. It then uses this data to personalize and dynamically update what users see based on every interaction, swipe, filter and sort. Explore [In-Session Personalization](https://www.algolia.com/about/news/algolia-unveils-new-ai-personalization).
What is Agent Studio and is it different from generic agent builders or chatbots? 0
Agent Studio is a platform for building and launching intelligent agents grounded in live Algolia search data. It’s different from generic alternatives because it is retrieval-first, not model-first. Responses are grounded in live Algolia indices, merchandising, rules, and relevance stay centralized, governance and brand safety are stronger, and hallucinations are reduced compared to generic LLM-only agents. Get the details on [Agent Studio](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai/agent-studio "Agent Studio"). 
What are Algolia Generative Experiences? 0
Generative Experiences helps businesses build and deploy generative AI-powered features for any use case using Algolia’s APIs, UX libraries, and merchandising tools. Learn more about [Generative Experiences](https://www.algolia.com/products/ai/generative-experiences "Generative Experiences"). 
How does Algolia connect AI-powered search, generative experiences, and agentic ecommerce? 0
The Algolia AI platform fuses search, language, and logic to serve relevance at scale. Blending advanced search algorithms, large language models (LLMs), and retrieval-augmented generation to deliver deeply personalized, high-performing user experiences with real-time relevance. See the [benefits of a connected approach](https://www.algolia.com/products "Products").
How much does Algolia cost? 0
We have a range of pricing options, to cater to the needs of different fashion or lifestyle businesses. You can even personalize your package to find the perfect fit for your business. Explore our personalized [pricing](https://www.algolia.com/pricing "Pricing")
